description: This file defines the MetaController class within the Api\V8\Controller namespace for a SuiteCRM-related project. It handles API endpoints related to metadata such as module list, field list, and Swagger schema by delegating to a MetaService. The class includes methods for fetching module lists, field lists, and schema, with exception handling. It is integral to the API layer of the project.

classes.name: MetaController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for retrieving metadata such as module list, field list, and Swagger schema in the SuiteCRM API.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Handles requests to fetch a list of modules via MetaService and returns a JSON response or error.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Handles requests to fetch a list of fields using MetaService with given parameters and returns a JSON response or error.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Fetches the Swagger schema using MetaService and returns it as a JSON response or error.
